info.title: Ghost-Rider Road Quality API
info.description: Automated visible road condition assessment for Indian roads. Exposes durable uploads, live camera capture, route aggregation, and Amazon Bedrock factual narration.

post.description: Create a private upload slot and return a presigned S3 or bounded local upload URL.

put.summary: Upload bytes to a private slot (S3-less / local fallback)
put.description: Bounded streaming upload used when no S3 bucket is configured, and by the local/replay demonstration path. The object is written under the media root at the slot's private object key and validated by magic header.

schema.title: Response Upload Local V1 Uploads  Upload Id  Local Put

post.summary: Finalize an upload and enqueue analysis
post.description: Verify uploaded object existence, size and format, record metadata, and enqueue processing.
Start a capture session with explicit mode, camera and calibration.

post.summary: Accept a frame for a session
post.description: Accept one frame with original reference, capture times and telemetry.
Close the capture session and request segment aggregation.

get.description: Return lifecycle state, error reason, attempt count and versions.
Return evidence, metrics, quality, score and narrative status.

get.summary: Return bin summaries and coverage truth
get.description: Return 50 m bin summaries with coverage truth and unsampled stretches.

post.summary: Generate factual report and Bedrock wording
post.description: Generate a structured report and optional Bedrock narrative from stored facts.

get.description: State model/worker/storage/integration readiness in the v1 shape.
Cheap liveness probe - safe to poll from a target group every few seconds.
Probe database, S3, Bedrock, the YOLO model and local storage.
